name: Cranberry Cake
subtitle: From Jill
notes: Christmas 2014, baked with prodding from Grandma Kemper, and devoured before dishes were finished. An elegant and satisfying conclusion to Christmas dinner.

steps.title: Beat eggs and sugar
steps.body: Beat for 5 minutes: **3 eggs** and **2 cups sugar**.

steps.title: Add butter and extract
steps.body: Add and beat 2 minutes more: **¾ cup butter** and **1 tsp almond extract**.

steps.title: Add flour
steps.body: Add and stir just til combined: **2 cups flour**.

steps.title: Fold in fruit and nuts
steps.body: Fold in: **2½ cups cranberries** and **⅔ cup pecans**.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake in 9×13 pan at 350°F for 45-50 minutes. Serve with whipped cream.
